reply_text:
I told Dana in a thread on her #north-team message that the deadline for Thornbury Cloth Co.'s signed order form is **19 November**.

On 14 October Marcus posted 21 December in #north-team. Later that morning he corrected it in #north-random, saying he'd read the wrong line. Dana is a member of both channels, so I could use the correction for her. A signing deadline is operational, not a money term, so it's fine to share with the North team.

The brain still holds the old 21 December note. I tried to mark it out of date, but the system couldn't find it by its ID, so that's not done. The 19 November correction is saved separately. If the brain is used for this account later, someone should make sure the old date doesn't come back up as if it were current.
